source: JPX / J-Quants daily stock prices as distributed for the Kaggle 'JPX Tokyo Stock Exchange Prediction' competition (train_files/stock_prices.csv, 2017-01-04..2021-12-03; Close = unadjusted TSE close, AdjustmentFactor column ignored), mirrored in Git LFS at https://media.githubusercontent.com/media/1on1pt/JPX_Tokyo_Stock_Exchange_Prediction/main/train_files/stock_prices.csv (LFS pointer https://raw.githubusercontent.com/1on1pt/JPX_Tokyo_Stock_Exchange_Prediction/main/train_files/stock_prices.csv); only the quarter-end byte ranges were downloaded (HTTP Range), rows SecuritiesCode=7011. Value = last TSE session close on/before each calendar quarter end. Split basis 2025-12-31: raw as-is before ex-date 2017-09-27 (1:10 consolidation 2017-10-01 and 10:1 split 2024-04-01 cancel), raw /10 from 2017-09-27. No independent second mirror found; only the transcribed series was compared.
